title: Degree one of the completed normalized positive Chern adjunct
statement: For a DiagonalTrace.Result tq for f:X -> S [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation] with X,S Noetherian, DiagonalTraceLocalizations and l invertible on S, let a:completedUnit(S) -> tq.Rc.R(completedLine(X)[2]) satisfy the whole-system normalized Chern equation of [lem-diagonal-completed-chern-lift]. Then a followed by tq.trace is the identity of completedUnit(S). No realization or scalar extension is involved.

source.place: Paragraph (1), the positive Chern summand and the normalized completed trace.

proof.text: Use the strict twisted-splitting Chern component formula and the definition of the trace as inverse splitting followed by the second projection. Cancel the splitting and use biprod.inr_snd to obtain degree one.

Restrict this equation to the actual constant systems. Paste with the completed Chern normalization and the defining trace square. The completed-unit comparison is invertible, and restriction on completed-unit arrows is injective; cancel both to get the completed equation.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_chern_degree
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (tq : DiagonalTrace.Result l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (c : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l S ⟶
      tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l X) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hc : (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S).map c ≫
        tq.toPresentation.sourceMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) =
      tq.coefficientsS.unitMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) tq.LS ≫
        tq.LS.R.map (tq.toPresentation.systemChern l)) : c ≫ tq.trace = 𝟙 _
